aggregation_order: Pre-aggregate many-side fee/settlement/reverse tables before joining where the source query or reconciliation section implies many-to-one.
filters: Use active-row and source-specified marketplace filters; scope fields remain columns/caveats only.
formula_text:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', settlement_date) AS month,
  SUM(tcs_taxable_amount) AS tcs_base_from_sales,
  (SELECT SUM(ABS(total_tcs_amount)) FROM zs_observe.meesho_settlement
   WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'Delivered') AS tcs_deducted_in_settlement
FROM zs_observe.meesho_sales WHERE is_active = true
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
